title: Nano Learns What Teammates Are For — Part 4

series.summary: While the guards fuss over the cat, the team finds a dropped airmail letter, and Karane confronts lone-wolf Nano about what friends on a team are actually for.

segments.voiceover_text: The hallway patrol never spots them — the guards are too busy babying that same grumpy cat. Then the team finds a dropped airmail letter on the floor, sent from overseas. Whatever it says, it matters to this mansion.

The letter reveals Nano's path — a top student bound for a university abroad, convinced she works best alone. Karane will not hear it. Friends who share everything are what make a team. You are going to be a good team too, she insists — and Nano's cool mask finally cracks. Good thing, too — because the next hallway aims a hundred red eyes straight at them.
